tools.name: list_propositions
tools.description: List Plumbline's services with a one-line summary: lookups that run instantly, and requirements you can send.

tools.name: describe_proposition
tools.description: Everything about one service: what happens to a request, what you get, scope and limits, the request fields and any operations.

tools.name: submit_request
tools.description: Send a requirement to one of Plumbline's services. It is kept with a reference number.

tools.name: screen_sanctions
tools.description: Screen a name against the OFAC SDN list and aliases. A match is a lead for review, not a determination.

tools.name: company_financial_facts
tools.description: Reported XBRL values of one concept for one SEC filer, with period, form and accession number.

tools.name: federal_contract_awards
tools.description: US federal contract actions (awards and modifications) by vendor name, NAICS code, place-of-performance state and fiscal year, ten at a time, from FPDS, the government's contract reporting system.

tools.name: entity_lookup
tools.description: LEI records and SEC EDGAR registration for a company. Paid per call over HTTP with x402 ($0.02); this tool returns how to call it.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: screen_sanctions · Private data: entity_lookup · Public sink: list_propositions, submit_request · Destructive: list_propositions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: screen_sanctions · Private data: entity_lookup · Public sink: list_propositions, submit_request · Destructive: list_propositions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
